files.title: Maximum candidate files
files.summary: Sets how many source files are selected for evaluation.
files.description: Restricts the number of documents considered during candidate discovery.

passages.title: Passage count
passages.summary: Sets the number of evidence passages considered.
passages.description: Controls how many retrieved passages can contribute to the tool result.

passage_tokens.title: Passage token budget
passage_tokens.summary: Limits tokens devoted to retrieved evidence passages.
passage_tokens.description: Constrains the amount of passage text supplied for model analysis.

quick_files.title: Quick-pass files
quick_files.summary: Limits candidate files scanned in a quick pass.

confirmation.title: Confirmation policy
confirmation.summary: Controls when user confirmation is required before a tool runs.
confirmation.description: Depending on the selected policy, the tool may ask before processing large or otherwise costly workloads.

large_batches.title: Large workload threshold
large_batches.summary: Sets the batch threshold used by the confirmation policy.
large_batches.description: Used to decide whether a planned multi-batch operation is large enough to request confirmation.

discovery_strategy.title: Discovery strategy
discovery_strategy.summary: Selects the retrieval approach used to discover references.
discovery_strategy.description: Changes how the tool identifies likely evidence-bearing documents.

discovery_tokens.title: Discovery token budget
discovery_tokens.summary: Sets the token budget for reference discovery.
discovery_tokens.description: Limits the amount of retrieved context considered while searching for plausible references.
